correctness.rationale: A valuation makes Delta p at w constantly true if |R(w)|<=1; otherwise Delta p is the Boolean predicate that p is homogeneous on the successor set. Distinct nonsingleton successor sets yield distinct predicates, so validity of Delta Delta p is equivalent to the type of every world in R(w) being equal. Partition all rows into type0 and distinct nonfunctional row classes; choose labels in at most (n+1)^n, type0 row choices (n+1)^n, target class for each nonfunctional row (n+1)^n, and subset row choices at most 2^{Mk} where k<=n-M+1, giving Mk<=(n+1)^2/4. Lower family: a=floor(n/2) empty-row worlds; each of b others points to fixed pair in the a-set plus arbitrary subset of remaining a-2, yielding 2^{(a-2)b}. Hence log2 a_n/n^2->1/4, proportion=2^{-3n^2/4+O(n log n)}. Independent exhaustive raw Boolean truth tables and structurally inferred condition agree on all 2^{n^2} frames for n=1..4, exact counts (2,10,128,3070); lower witnesses checked through n=9. General theorem follows from symbolic proof, not finite enumeration.
